programme.title: Bekhudi
programme.desc: Radhika agrees to marry the boy her parents choose for her. Later, she falls in love with Rohit. The parents and her fiancé get together to force her to comply with their wishes.

programme.title: Jaagruti
programme.desc: Sevalal, a corrupt minister, kills Vishal, an honest police officer. So Vishal's brother Jugnu vows to avenge his death.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: No Entry
programme.desc: A gorgeous club dancer's ill-timed rendezvous opens up a Pandora's box of lies, absurdities and misunderstandings in the lives of three quirky couples.

programme.title: Aakhree Raasta
programme.desc: A man is falsely accused of his wife's murder and imprisoned. When he sets out to seek revenge, he finds a police officer on his trail who turns out to be his own son.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Vijay lives in a village with his family. He makes an enemy with Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who devises a plan to throw the former out of the village.

programme.title: Hogi Pyar Ki Jeet
programme.desc: Two brothers attempt to fulfil their dying father's wish by marrying two daughters of an old enemy, intending to exact revenge.

programme.title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
programme.desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, against his domineering mother Kamla's wishes. In a bid to get rid of Shalu, Kamla frames her and accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

programme.title: Kohram
programme.desc: When a teacher is killed by two village tyrants, Thakur and Kalia, his brother Arjun swears to avenge him. Years later, Arjun kills Thakur and then joins forces with his brother's sons to face Kalia.

programme.title: Trimurti
programme.desc: A wrongfully convicted policewoman expects her three children to settle scores with her enemy. But when the long-awaited moment arrives, luck does not seem to be on her side.

programme.title: Jaane Hoga Kya
programme.desc: Siddharth, a young and ambitious scientist, is determined to create a perfect human clone. When he finally achieves his goal, he realizes that he has unlocked a Pandora's box of horrors.

programme.title: Aashiq
programme.desc: Pooja and Chander fall in love and want to be together. However, since Pooja's alcoholic father would never approve, she decides to run away from her house but, unfortunately, lands in a brothel.

programme.title: Main Tera Dushman
programme.desc: When a Forest Officer, Kishan Srivastav, hinders the criminal activities of Thakur Dayalu, he is framed for murder and sent to jail. Later, Kishan escapes prison and tries to clear his name.

programme.title: Chaalbaaz
programme.desc: Anju endures mistreatment at home, whereas her long-separated twin Manju boldly navigates life's challenges. By some quirk of fate, they end up trading places, and their worlds erupt in chaos.

programme.title: Masoom
programme.desc: D K Malhotra leads a peaceful life with his wife and two daughters. But all of this changes when he is forced to bring a boy, who is his son from a previous relationship, home after his mother dies.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: Pratap, a gambler disowned by his family, comes under the care of a landlord named Laxminath. When corrupt forces lead to Laxminath's murder, Pratap seeks revenge.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Gangster henchman Satya falls in love with the stunning Sapna. Meanwhile, rival factions scheme to exploit his newfound affection.

programme.title: Sahibaan
programme.desc: After being rejected by Sahibaan, Vijay, a philanderer, learns about her love affair with Gopi, a labourer. Soon, a distressed Vijay decides to kill Gopi.

programme.title: Pukar
programme.desc: Major Jaidev saves a politician from the clutches of a dreaded terrorist. However, the terrorist joins hands with his childhood friend Anjali to ruin his life.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Bahon Mein
programme.desc: Lovers Sagar and Sapna separate due to her father's opposition and meet after many years. However, Sagar reveals that he is to marry Kavita, while Sapna is about to be engaged to Rakesh.

programme.title: Krishna
programme.desc: The life of Sunil, an aspiring pilot, takes a disastrous turn when he is falsely convicted for a crime he did not commit.

programme.title: Gambler
programme.desc: Though Inspector Dayashanker is lazy, he unwittingly unearths a criminal conspiracy and becomes the pride of his division overnight. However, a local gangster turns his life into a nightmare.

programme.title: Maha Sangram
programme.desc: Vishal, a farmer, sends his brother, Arjun, to the city for higher education. However, when Arjun falls in love with a girl in the city and gets murdered by her father, Vishal seeks revenge.

programme.title: Marte Dam Tak
programme.desc: When a hitman accidentally kills the wrong man, he is sentenced to a life of looking after his boss's blind daughter.

programme.title: Dadagiri
programme.desc: A quarrel arises between Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Vishnu resulting in them meddling in the lives of a settlement broker and a taxi driver.

programme.title: Kotee
programme.desc: In the corrupt city of Janatha, Kotee, an honest man, defies the ruthless criminal Dinoo Savarkar in a bid to secure a better future for his sister. However, his defiance leads to overwhelming debts.

programme.title: Zulm Ki Zanjeer

programme.title: Parking

programme.desc: Upon getting adopted by the Littles, Stuart, a mouse, is unwelcomed by his new brother George. So, when Stuart begins to feel low the family helps him find his real parents.

programme.title: Sniper: The Last Stand
programme.desc: With time running against him, skilled sniper Brandon Beckett, along with Agent Zero, must commandeer an elite task force to prevent the release of a fatal weapon.
Micky, a maths professor, enlists five gifted students to use their abilities to win millions at blackjack in Las Vegas. He exploits their talents for personal gain in the glamorous casino city.

programme.title: Fatherhood
programme.desc: A widower embarks on an emotional journey while raising his daughter single-handedly despite encountering several hurdles along the way.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A dying curator of the Louvre hides cryptic clues on Da Vinci paintings. Now it is up to Robert Langdon and Sophie Neveu to follow the clues and unearth a secret kept hidden for centuries.

programme.title: Hancock
programme.desc: A hard-living superhero who has fallen out of favor with the public enters into a questionable relationship with the wife of the public relations professional who's trying to repair his image.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: Agent M, a probationary member of the MIB, teams up with Agent H and uncovers a sinister plot that reveals a traitor in the organisation aiding an alien invasion.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong, a mischievous young boy, learns a special form of martial arts from his alcoholic master in order to prevent an assassin from executing his goals.

programme.title: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
programme.desc: John Connor, a cybernetic warrior from the future, travels back in time to accomplish his mission of protecting a man and his future wife, Kate, from a robotic attack.

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: When the monsters from his 'Goosebumps' book series come to life and invade the real world, author R L Stine must save his town with the help of his daughter, Hannah, and neighbour, Zach.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: A dangerous mutation of the rage virus starts to spread to survivors.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: K, an officer with the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a secret that could create chaos. He goes in search of a former Blade Runner who has been missing for over three decades.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Eddie, a journalist, is determined to expose the Life Foundation, for performing unethical experiments on humans. During his investigation, a symbiotic alien merges with him, ensuing chaos.

programme.desc: Notorious for his relationships with women, a single Kuttiyappan's life takes a turn when he sets out to fulfil one of his strange dreams.

programme.title: Five Fingers
programme.desc: Manu, Meera, Rafeeq, Ashok and Vijayakumar study together in a college. The five friends share a close bond and are always willing to fight for each other.

programme.title: Rosapoo
programme.desc: Shajahan struggles to make ends meet after suffering a huge loss in his duty-free shop. His friend Neeraj, who aspires to become a director, ropes Shajahan into his idea of making an adult film.

programme.title: Vakkalathu Narayanankutty
programme.desc: Narayankutty wishes to be a lawyer but ends up being a clerk in a government office. However, when he sees the law being breached or misused, he does not hesitate to raise his voice against it.

programme.title: Oru Mexican Aparatha
programme.desc: Paul, a student from Thrissur, joins Maharaja's College in Ernakulam where he befriends Subhash. Along with him, they strive to reintroduce the SFY party on campus.

programme.title: Mamangam
programme.desc: During the Mamangam fair, a new legend is born when a 12-year-old boy, Chandroth Valiya Panikkar, survives a battle with the mighty army of Zamorin.

programme.title: Taxiwala
programme.desc: When a taxi driver begins to experience various eerie events in his vehicle, he strives to uncover the truth behind the mysterious occurrences.

programme.title: Traffic
programme.desc: Travelling from Mumbai to Pune in a four-wheeler, a motley crew of unlikely heroes must race against time to deliver a heart to a 13-year-old patient.

programme.title: Aakasam
programme.desc: Manoharan leads a peaceful life with his family. However, fear engulfs him when he realises that a sketch of a wanted terrorist resembles him.

programme.title: Lava Kusha
programme.desc: Two men without any specific aim, desire to be policemen. One day, they happen to cross paths with Joy, an undercover police officer, and decide to help him out.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln
programme.desc: Abraham and Lincoln are drawn into a turbulent world of crime and loyalty, where personal choices and past ties shape their unpredictable path.

programme.title: Killadi Raman
programme.desc: Mahadevan is a live witness of Radhika's hit-and-run accident. His helpful gesture of taking Radhika to the hospital, however, lands him in trouble when he is confronted by Meera, Radhika's friend.

programme.title: Sundarakilladi
programme.desc: Without knowing the risk of his work, a man goes to a village to dig a well as they are facing water scarcity. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with a girl.

programme.title: Rani Padmini
programme.desc: Rani and Padmini, two women with different agendas, embark on an unfamiliar journey while getting to know each other and help each other through personal conflicts.

programme.title: Sallapam
programme.desc: Radha and Sasikumar fall in love with each other. However, her life takes a turn when he refuses to marry her because of his family problems.

programme.title: Skanda
programme.desc: A skilled martial artist's life changes when a secret agency recruits him to stop terrorists. He faces a dangerous mission that will test his abilities and courage beyond anything he is known.

programme.title: Bangalore Days
programme.desc: Three cousins, Divya, Krishnan and Arjuna, share a close bond and decide to move to Bangalore to fulfil their childhood dreams. There, they face challenges that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Jawan of Vellimala
